summary: ECHOES OF SPACE is an interactive educational storytelling platform that explores abandoned and inactive human-made space equipment on the Moon and Mars. It brings the stories of spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific instruments to life through immersive visual storytelling, NASA data, real mission information, and interactive experiences. The project aims to help students understand the scientific and historical significance of space exploration hardware that remains beyond Earth.
details: ECHOES OF SPACE is an interactive web-based educational experience developed to address NASA Space Apps Challenge's theme of abandoned space equipment. The platform explores the legacy of human-made equipment left on the Moon and Mars, including spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific instruments. It presents their missions, scientific contributions, operational history, and current status through an engaging storytelling experience. Key features include: - Interactive storytelling about space exploration equipment. - Educational information about NASA missions. - Visual exploration of abandoned space hardware. - NASA-related images and factual information. - Interactive website navigation and learning experiences. The project combines web development, visual storytelling, and space science education to make complex mission histories accessible and engaging for students. The platform was developed using AI-assisted development tools and web technologies. Its goal is to encourage curiosity about space exploration and demonstrate that even equipment that has completed its mission leaves behind an important scientific legacy.
